title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_atlas_der_umweltmigration_by_dina_ionesco_daria_mokhnacheva_francois_gemenne_z0kn1 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_atlas_der_umweltmigration_by_dina_ionesco_daria_mokhnacheva_francois_gemenne_z0kn1' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by the package, as full control of the system may have been granted to an attacker.
